name: Performance, Load & Stress Testing
description: Performance, Load & Stress Testing standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-PERF-TEST applies.

rules.title: Define measurable performance objectives before testing
rules.detail: Specify workload, concurrency, dataset, latency percentiles, throughput, error rate and resource limits aligned with relevant SLOs.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define measurable performance objectives before testing.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define measurable performance objectives before testing.

rules.title: Separate load, stress, spike, endurance and capacity scenarios
rules.detail: Choose the test type based on the risk being evaluated and document expected behavior for each scenario.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate load, stress, spike, endurance and capacity scenarios.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate load, stress, spike, endurance and capacity scenarios.

rules.title: Test production-representative critical paths
rules.detail: Use realistic request mix, payload sizes, authentication, cache state and data volume; synthetic trivial endpoints are insufficient.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test production-representative critical paths.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test production-representative critical paths.

rules.title: Capture server and dependency telemetry during tests
rules.detail: Correlate latency with CPU, memory, GC, database, cache, queue and downstream metrics so bottlenecks can be diagnosed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Capture server and dependency telemetry during tests.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Capture server and dependency telemetry during tests.

rules.title: Define pass/fail thresholds and regression budgets
rules.detail: Performance tests must fail when agreed latency, error, throughput or resource thresholds regress beyond the accepted budget.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define pass/fail thresholds and regression budgets.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define pass/fail thresholds and regression budgets.

rules.title: Protect production and shared environments
rules.detail: Load generation requires rate controls, test data isolation and approval when it could affect real users or shared dependencies.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Protect production and shared environments.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Protect production and shared environments.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-PERF-TEST applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Performance, Load & Stress Testing to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Performance, Load & Stress Testing is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Performance, Load & Stress Testing failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
